summary: Tested CV scanning + structured extraction feature end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass (auth guards, status shape/coherence, per-user rescan with data verification, non-existent user handling, batch scan, AI search regression). Frontend: cv-scan-panel visible in AdminCandidates with correct stats (7 total / 6 scanned / 1 pending / 1 error) matching backend. Buttons cv-scan-all-btn, cv-scan-force-btn, cv-scan-refresh all present and clickable. CV preview dialog opens correctly when clicking a cv-snippet row after a text search — cv-structured shows Poste + skills chips (Python, Docker, analyse de donnees), cv-preview-text shows raw OCR text, cv-rescan-btn and open-original-cv-btn present.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking 'Scanner les CV non scannés' the button label did NOT switch to 'Scan en cours…'. Likely because the backend responded with status='busy' (a previous background scan was still running) OR because scan={running:true} state is only refreshed on next loadScan() poll. Minor UX polish only — API call is fired correctly.

action_items: (Optional/polish) After POST /cv-scan/all click, immediately call loadScan() so the button visibly reflects 'Scan en cours…' without waiting for the next user-triggered refresh.
(Optional) Consider auto-polling /cv-scan/status every 5–10s while scan.running is true so admins see progress live.
critical_code_review_comments: cv_scan.py::cv_scan_status computes pending = total_cv - scanned but does NOT subtract errors. If a CV is in error state it counts as pending, which is arguably correct (still retryable) but the label 'À scanner' on the UI may be misleading. Consider pending = total_cv - scanned - errors, or rename UI label.

core.py::scan_all_cvs uses an in-process `_scan_lock` dict — will not prevent duplicate scans if the app runs under multiple workers. Acceptable for single-worker uvicorn setup; document the constraint.
core.py::parse_cv_structured tmp file is created inside the try/finally but if NamedTemporaryFile write itself fails before assignment tmp_path remains None (OK). No leaks observed.
cv_scan.py POST /cv-scan/all returns 200 even when {status:'busy'} — semantically OK but consider 409 for machine consumers.
